About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

ElevenLabs is looking for a Head of Strategic Pursuits to lead our largest, most complex and most transformational enterprise deals around the world, from first executive conversation through signature and into deployment.
This is a global leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer. Strategic Pursuits is not traditional sales support. It is a specialized deal leadership function that partners with Account Executives to win opportunities that require significantly more executive engagement, creativity, and cross-functional coordination than a standard sales cycle. These are the deals that don't fit the playbook. They are structured in new ways, they involve multiple senior stakeholders on the customer side (and sometimes their boards and investors), and they pull in nearly every function at ElevenLabs to get done.
You will own the pursuit strategy for these opportunities. That means shaping the transformation narrative with the customer's C-suite, building the business case, designing the solution and the commercial model, running the negotiation, and bringing Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and our own executives together to move the deal forward and clear what's in the way. You will turn what we learn from each strategic pursuit into repeatable motions: playbooks the field can reuse, input into how we price and package, signal to Product on what our largest customers need, and clean handoffs into deployment so what we sold is what gets delivered.
This is not a sales operations, deal desk, or program management role, and it is not a quota-carrying territory role. We are looking for someone who has personally led and structured nine-figure-scale, multi-year enterprise deals, is comfortable going well outside the playbook to get them done, and has the executive presence to sit across from a Fortune 500 CEO. While initially a senior IC role, there is the potential to build out a team under this function.

Develop C-suite relationships at our most important customers and prospects, shape transformation narratives, and create compelling business cases tied to measurable outcomes. Bring in the CRO, CEO, and other ElevenLabs executives at the right moments with a clear role for each.
• 
Orchestrate cross-functional execution. Bring together Sales, Product, Engineering, FDE, Finance, Legal, Partners, and executive sponsors to accelerate deal progression and remove blockers. Run the pursuit like a program, with a clear plan, owners, and a cadence, without becoming the bottleneck.
• 
Structure and win complex transactions. Drive competitive strategy, solution design, commercial models, negotiations, and creative deal structures (multi-year commitments, partnerships, co-development, platform and marketplace models, and others we haven't invented yet) to secure transformational agreements that are good for the customer and for ElevenLabs.
• 
Work across senior stakeholders on both sides. Navigate complex buying committees, procurement, legal, and in some cases boards and investors, and keep the deal moving when it gets stuck at the top.
• 
Partner on global and strategic accounts. Work closely with regional leaders and account teams on our most important global accounts, bringing a consistent strategy across regions and product lines.
• 
Build repeatable winning motions. Turn strategic deals into scalable playbooks, improve pricing and packaging, influence product priorities with evidence from the largest deals in the market, and ensure successful handoffs into deployment.

Raise the bar on deal craft across the org. Coach AEs and regional leaders on executive selling, business case development, and deal structuring so the whole Revenue organization gets better at winning big.

Be the CRO's partner on big bets. Bring a clear point of view on which deals to pursue, how to structure them, and when to walk away, and represent that view in leadership and executive forums.

Requirements

15+ years of relevant experience in enterprise sales, strategic deals, or business development at technology companies, with a track record of leading and closing very large, complex, multi-year transactions.

About the job
About Mobilewalla
Mobilewalla is a data and AI company that turns large-scale, privacy-compliant consumer behavioural data into intelligence products and vertical agentic AI solutions. Our proprietary platform is built on more than a decade of longitudinal signals covering roughly 2 billion devices across 40+ countries, and ingests around 50 TB of data every day.
We serve 200+ businesses worldwide, with a focus on telecommunications and financial services. Our product portfolio includes:
• Mobilewalla Data Platform — the core consumer data platform — audience segments, data enrichment, identity and engineered features for modelling
• Market Flow — granular telecom market intelligence: market share, subscriber inflow/outflow and competitive dynamics at local-area level
• Telescope — an agentic AI platform that lets telecom operators ask specific competitive and operational questions in natural language, grounded in our proprietary data
• LendBetter — data and analytics for lenders: credit-risk modelling, new-to-credit customer identification and fraud prevention

The Role
As an Associate Product Manager, you will work alongside senior PMs to define, build and launch data and AI products used by telecom operators, lenders and marketers. This is a hands-on, high-learning role: you will own well-scoped features end to end, get deep into the data that powers them, and work daily with data engineering, data science, design and our commercial teams.
You do not need years of PM experience. You do need curiosity about data, comfort with ambiguity, and the drive to turn a messy customer question into a clear, shippable product.
What You Will Do
• Write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria for features on Products
• Investigate client-reported issues in depth, find the root cause, and work with Engineering and Data Science to get them resolved
• Research competitors and market trends, and evaluate new data sources for quality, coverage and fit with our products
• Own and groom a backlog for a feature area; run sprint ceremonies with engineering and keep work moving in Jira
• Write and QA SQL to validate datasets, investigate anomalies and answer product questions yourself
• Define and track product metrics — usage, data quality and coverage and report insights to the team
• Use AI tools in your own workflow to speed up research, spec writing, prototyping and analysis
• Look for problems to solve and improve existing workflows

What We Are Looking For
Must-haves
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business or a related quantitative field
• 0–2 years of experience in product management, business/data analysis, consulting, solutions engineering or software development — internships and substantial projects count
• Working SQL skills; able to query, join and sanity-check data independently
• Strong structured thinking and written communication — you can explain a technical trade-off to an engineer and a business outcome to a customer
• Comfort working across time zones with distributed teams in Asia and North America
• A genuine interest in data products and applied AI, and a bias for action
Nice-to-haves
• Exposure to telecom/broadband, fintech/lending, adtech or location/mobility data
• Exposure to agentic architectures — orchestration, multi-source retrieval, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop feedback loops
• Familiarity with cloud data tooling (e.g., AWS, S3, Athena) and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
• Basic Python for analysis, or experience working with geospatial data
• Understanding of data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, PDPA) and privacy-by-design practices
• Experience with Agile/Scrum and tools such as Jira, Confluence and Figma

Why Join Us
• Work on genuinely large-scale data — billions of devices, petabyte-scale storage — and on vertical AI products already in front of major telecom operators
• A small, senior team where junior PMs get real ownership and direct mentorship
• A clear growth path from Associate PM to Product Manager
